label: Finding-25
title: latvia-offline: "Pulled from the public internet" overstates a geo-block
description: CERT.LV says access was restricted from abroad, selectively, and that residents accessing from Latvia should not be affected ("Paredzams, ka iedz_vot_jus, kuri valsts digit_lajiem pakalpojumiem piek__st no Latvijas, _ie ierobe_ojumi neietekm_s"). The note should say geo-blocked from abroad, not pulled from the public internet.
